answer: An agent earns voting weight only after locking 20 POA for 12 epochs and completing four distinct jobs reviewed by three randomly selected, established peers. A false identity loses 15% of its bond when an audit confirms reused evidence or coordinated funding. Public signatures let reviewers detect a jade credential reused across accounts; a ledge of minimum reputation separates newcomers from privileged actions, while reaching the summit requires a clean record over time. Each extra sybil therefore pays a separate bond and review cost.
